| [CASE-206](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-206.md) v3 | A single flat-foldable degree-4 vertex under a footprint budget: its two folding modes meet only at the flat state, so passing between folded states needs the full flat footprint of 1.866, more than twice what either folded state at 150° takes | Filed at the owner's request on 2026-11-05, to file "one or more CASEs for origami as a toy model of a resource bounded constraint configuration space". The minimal toy: one rigid flat-foldable vertex with sector angles 60°, 90°, 120° and 90°, whose configuration space is two folding modes meeting only at the flat state, and a declared resource, the plan area of the smallest convex tray that holds it.
